verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never names Okta, Entra ID or Google Workspace, and it does not document any IdP integration or policy requiring hardware-key authentication. It only offers generic FIDO2/WebAuthn and phishing-resistant MFA claims, relying-party developer SDKs, and PIV attestation. Those are building blocks or adjacent features, not documented IdP integration, and policy enforcement would sit with the IdP, which is a host-platform capability.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the key integrates with my identity provider — Okta, Entra ID, Google Workspace — and I can enforce policies requiring hardware-key authentication
